summary: An alert dialog driven by parent state: the pending prop is set for 1.5 seconds before the dialog closes itself.
use: Publishing or saving flows where the confirm button must show progress and the parent decides when to close.
spec: `<AlertDialog bind:open title="Publish changes?" confirmLabel="Publish"` with no description
`{pending}` shorthand passes `let pending = $state(false)` to the dialog
`onconfirm={publish}` sets `pending = true`, awaits 1500 ms, then sets `pending = false` and `open = false`
Trigger is `<Button variant="outlined"` labelled Open controlled
